00057  /**
00058   * @brief Action Messages
00059   *
00060   * These messages are sent from the various Hx UI toolkit widgets.
00061   * Applications can use HxWidgetMapMessageCallback to associate an action
00062   * message callback with a widget.  The widget's ID is passes within the
00063   * message, and can be extracted using HxMessageGetSenderID.
00064   */
00065 enum {
00066     /**
00067      * @brief kHxAnyActionMessage is intended for system use only.
00068      * The callback for this message is called for every action message.
00069      */
00070     kHxAnyActionMessage = 0,
00071     
00072     /**
00073      * @brief The kHxCheckboxChanged message is sent in response to a button
00074      * press or space key press changing the checkbox state.  The system calls
00075      * the message callback from the input event handler.
00076      */
00077     kHxCheckboxChanged,
00078

00084     kHxRadiobuttonChanged,                              
00085

00088      * button press or space key press changing the command button state.  The
00089      * system calls the message callback from the input event handler.
00090      */
00091     kHxCommandButtonChanged,
00092                                 
00093     /**
00094      * @brief The kHxListSelected message is sent for several widgets that
00095      * contain lists.
00096      *
00097      * For dropdown boxes, the message is sent when the user performs an action
00098      * that changes the list item displayed in the dropdown box.  The message
00099      * is not sent as the user scrolls through the list displayed on the open
00100      * dropdown box window, because this does not change the item displayed in
00101      * the box.  Consequently, if the user opens the dropdown window, scrolls
00102      * through the list, and then dismisses the window by clicking outside the
00103      * window, no message is sent.
00104      *
00105      * For list boxes, this message is sent as the user changes the list item
00106      * that is highlighted.  This message is also sent when the highlighted
00107      * item is removed from the list using HxListRemoveItem.  This message is
00108      * also sent if the user selects an item that is already highlighted.
00109      */
00110     kHxListSelected,                                    
00111

00113      * @brief The kHxMenuSelected message is sent in response to the user
